steps.title: Configure Application Metadata
steps.description: Establish package namespace, app name, and asset configurations for QuickNotes.

steps.title: Configure Cloud Backend Schema
steps.description: Define API collections, authentication rules, and offline calculation logic schema.

steps.title: Create Project Gradle Scripts
steps.description: Configure Temurin 17, Gradle 8.5, and AGP 8.3.2 with pure Java 8 standard SDK configurations.

steps.title: Define Application Resources and Themes
steps.description: Create color palettes, clean styling, and visual drawables using Material Light themes.

steps.title: Implement Session and Token Manager
steps.description: Store authentication tokens, cached user emails, and local preferences securely via SharedPreferences.

steps.title: Develop Native Java Backend API Client
steps.description: Implement HttpURLConnection network operations for register, login, OTP recovery, and CRUD operations adhering to exact JSON contracts.

steps.title: Create Offline Note Business Logic Engine
steps.description: Implement pure Java calculations for word counts, character counts, reading time estimates, and note categorization metrics.

steps.title: Build User Authentication Interfaces
steps.description: Design and assemble login, user registration, and OTP-based password recovery layouts and activities.

steps.title: Build Main Notes Dashboard UI and Activity
steps.description: Implement search bar, category filtering chips, notes summary statistics cards, and scrollable notes list view.

steps.title: Build Note Editor UI and Logic
steps.description: Construct note creation and updating screen with live local character/word counter, color picker, and pin toggling.

steps.title: Configure AndroidManifest Configuration
steps.description: Declare internet permissions and register all application activities with required launch attributes.

steps.title: Building QuickNotes
steps.description: Compile native Android project into debug APK and verify complete dependency-free build pipeline.
